requirements.requirement_text: The inner container shall be of corrosion resistant material, or mild steel protected on all wetted surfaces by vitreous enamel, epoxy or an equivalent system.
Where a sacrificial anode is provided it shall be accessible for inspection and replacement without destroying any part of the appliance, and the inspection interval shall be declared.
Thermal insulation between the inner container and the outer body shall be non-hygroscopic and free from chlorides at a concentration that could promote stress corrosion.
A dedicated earthing terminal shall be provided, permanently marked with the earth symbol and bonded to all accessible metal parts.
Earth continuity resistance between the earthing terminal and any accessible metal part shall not exceed 0.1 ohm, measured per DEMO-STD-003 Clause 5.
The maximum thermostat setting shall not permit the mean stored water temperature to exceed 75 degC.
A thermal cut-out independent of the thermostat shall interrupt supply to the heating element if the stored water temperature exceeds 90 degC.
The thermal cut-out shall be manually resettable or require a tool to reset; an automatically resetting device shall not be the sole protective device.
The inner container shall withstand a hydrostatic pressure of twice the declared working pressure for 10 minutes without leakage or permanent deformation.
A pressure relief device set to operate at not more than 1.5 times the declared working pressure shall be fitted or supplied with appliances for pressurised supply.
A temperature rise type test at 1.06 times rated voltage shall be performed and the limits of DEMO-STD-002 Table 2 shall not be exceeded.
The 24 hour standing loss shall be measured and shall not exceed the value declared by the manufacturer.
Insulation resistance between live parts and accessible metal parts shall be not less than 2 megohms after humidity treatment.
The appliance shall withstand the electric strength test of DEMO-STD-003 Clause 7 without flashover or breakdown.
The rating label shall carry manufacturer name or trade mark, model, rated voltage, rated power, rated capacity, working pressure, standing loss, country of origin and year of manufacture.
The rating label shall remain legible after the water and petroleum spirit rub test.
Installation and user instructions shall be supplied in English and Hindi covering supply requirements, supply pressure limits, earthed circuit requirement and anode inspection interval.
A technical construction file containing the bill of materials, material certificates, type test reports and a declaration of conformity shall be maintained.
